hardware_evidence: Archive 1_Model/README.txt identifies test_models.py and gen_data.py as generators of initial_models.csv.
Both acquisition scripts connect using tclab.TCLab() and read a.T1/a.T2; no simulated TCLabModel is selected.
The actual irregular-time record is consistent with test_models.py real-time acquisition, not the integer-index loop in gen_data.py.
limitations: Commanded heater percentages and temperatures are measured/logged; electrical current and independent actuator-fault ground truth are absent.
No board serial number, exact acquisition date, or independently certified healthy label is included.
The record is treated as a nominal command experiment, not a labelled fault-detection benchmark.
release_scope: Offline computational inputs and attribution. The original manifest in provenance/ retains the URLs and hashes of ancillary source materials.
